chunks.content: New Beansland began as a settlement built by two Founders and the people who joined them along the way. As the settlement grew, responsibilities developed into the offices, teaching positions, and public roles that exist in New Beansland today.
Beans is one of the two Founders of New Beansland and is the primary connective voice for the world, its history, locations, people, books, entertainment, and institutions.

Allen “A.B.” Blake is Mayor of New Beansland. Professor Grey handles questions involving quality, judgment, value, and readiness. Tobias “T.M.” Mansfield examines rules, policies, exceptions, loopholes, eligibility, and limits.

sources.title: Jamel Hawkins — Founder of New Beansland

chunks.content: Jamel Hawkins is the founder of New Beansland, a creative home and public archive for books, stories, questions, frameworks, and connected fictional worlds.
His work includes The Doctor/Rocketship Test, The People Zoo, and the wider New Beansland creative universe.
The Founder’s Office on New Beansland is the interactive entry point into Jamel Hawkins’s role, projects, history, and the larger world behind the site.
The New Beansland Foundation Program in Applied Discernment brings together skeptical inquiry, analogical reasoning, and evidence-based practice in one three-course path.
The Foundation sequence is APSK 101 Foundations of Skeptical Inquiry, ANSY 110 Introduction to Analogical Reasoning, and EBPR 120 Foundations of Evidence-Based Practice.

The public University page is the enrollment door. Coursework itself is not presented as a public web classroom. New Beansland states that the completion certificate is not an accredited college degree or professional license.
NBL Books is the New Beansland bookstore and imprint for current books and editions.
Current public titles include The Doctor/Rocketship Test, The Doctor/Rocketship Test — Islamic Dilemma Edition, and The People Zoo.
Digital-edition prices and physical-print prices are separate by format. Lulu fulfills physical print editions listed on the bookstore.
NBL Clothing Co. is the New Beansland clothing catalog for adult streetwear, statement pieces, footwear, and current NBL Kids clothing.
Current catalog items are available now by request. Not So Small™ and NBL Pride are marked Coming Soon.
The NBL Identity Tee carries the line: Identity isn’t something you wear. It’s something you own.
NBL Kids is Shanique Washington’s division inside New Beansland, a family-friendly room she leads and designs for clothing, stories, creative releases, activities, and future projects.
Shanique Washington is Creative Lead & Designer for NBL Kids and also serves as New Beansland Fulfillment Manager.
Current kids clothing is available by request, while the Not So Small™ collection remains Coming Soon.
Stories & Film is the New Beansland public home for original stories, films, trailers, and soundtrack previews.
The City is still in development. Its official New Beansland trailer and soundtrack preview are available publicly.
The public story world also links visitors to The People Zoo, Doctor/Rocketship, and NBL Books.
Timmy V Studios is part of NBL Studios and NBL Records and is the public New Beansland studio for music, trailers, commercials, and releases.
The studio catalog includes music playback and media from NBL Studios, NBL Records, TV & Film, and NBL Clothing Co.
The New Beansland Founder’s Office is an interactive About page for Founder Jamel Hawkins.
Visitors can explore the one-room-light lamp puzzle, the empty chair, family keepsakes, academic certificates, the desk clue, and the connected story of New Beansland.
